title: I Come by the Blood
lyrics_original: You are the perfect and righteous God,
Whose presence bears no sin.
You bid me come to Your holy place,
How can I enter in, when Your presence bears no sin?
Through Him who poured out His life for me,
The Atoning Lamb of God.
Through Him and His work alone I boldly come!
I come by the Blood,
I come by the Cross
Where Your mercy flows
From hands pierced for me.
For I dare not stand on my righteousness,
My every hope rests on what Christ has done
And I come by the Blood.
You are the high and exalted King,
The One the angels fear.
So far above me in ev'ry way,
Lord how can I draw near,
To the One the angels fear?
Through Him who laid down His life for me,
And ascended to Your side,
Through Him, through Jesus alone, I boldly come!
I come by the Blood,
I come by the Cross
Where Your mercy flows
From hands pierced for me.
For I dare not stand on my righteousness,
My every hope rests on what Christ has done
And I come by the Blood.

bible_verses.english: Having therefore, brothers, boldness to enter into the holy place by the blood of Jesus, by the way which he dedicated for us, a new and living way, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh;
Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we will be saved from wrath through him.

knowing that you were redeemed, not with corruptible things, with silver or gold, from the useless way of life handed down from your forefathers, but with precious blood, as of a faultless and pure lamb, the blood of Christ;

devotional.prayer_english: Heavenly Father, thank You that I do not have to earn my way into Your presence. I come today clinging only to the cross of Jesus and the mercy that flows from His sacrifice. Wash away my fears and doubts in the light of His redeeming blood. Give me the confidence to draw near to You with a grateful and worshipful heart. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: Approaching a holy and perfect God can feel intimidating when we are mindful of our own weakness and sin. Yet, the gospel offers a breathtaking invitation: we do not draw near based on our own merit, but through the precious blood of Jesus. At the cross, His pierced hands poured out the mercy we so desperately needed. Today, come freely and boldly into His presence, resting entirely in the finished, redeeming work of the Atoning Lamb.
